road.name: SR-20 / North Cascades Highway
road.status: Paved and open in summer; unmarked climbers' pullout near milepost 165-166.
road.driveNote: Park at the pullout near MP 165-166, about 4 miles east of Washington Pass, near the Silver Star trail sign.
road.seasonalGate: WSDOT closes this stretch of SR 20 every winter, usually in mid-to-late November, and reopens it between mid-April and May; check WSDOT before an early- or late-season attempt.

evidence.measurement: USGS GNIS 1525796 'Silver Star Mountain' summit point

sql_fixes.why: Abegg: 4,626 ft from the car (parking 4,250 ft). Measured net: 8,876 (published summit) - 4,315 (USGS 3DEP at the stored trailhead pin) = 4,561 ft, within 2%.
